transcript.text: Good morning Priya, let's take a look at tooth 16 where you noticed cold sensitivity.
Yes, especially with iced water and chewing almonds on that side.

Examining tooth 16, there is a visible micro-crack along the mesio-palatal cusp. Tooth 46 also shows active occlusal caries. I recommend cuspal coverage with a full ceramic crown on tooth 16, a composite restoration on 46, and an occlusal night guard for nocturnal grinding.

findings.chiefComplaint: Cold sensitivity and sharp pain on biting right upper molar (tooth 16).
findings.history: No known allergies. Good general health. Reports clenching during stressful periods.
findings.toothFindings: FDI Tooth 16: Micro-crack running across mesio-palatal cusp, tender to Tooth Slooth on palatal cusp. FDI Tooth 46: Active occlusal enamel-dentine caries. Wear facets noted on anterior incisal edges consistent with nocturnal bruxism.
findings.findingsGingival: Mild marginal gingivitis, bleeding on probing 12%. Pockets 2-3mm.
findings.diagnosis: Cracked tooth syndrome tooth 16; active caries tooth 46; nocturnal attrition/bruxism.
findings.treatmentPerformed: Comprehensive examination 011, intraoral bite-wing radiographs 022, bite test.
findings.recommendations: Full ceramic crown on tooth 16 to protect against fracture; 2-surface composite resin on tooth 46; upper Michigan occlusal splint.

consultations.patientSummary:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for coming in today for your comprehensive examination. We evaluated tooth 16 where you have been experiencing biting sensitivity, and identified a structural micro-crack that requires a protective ceramic crown to prevent further splitting. We also noted minor decay on tooth 46 for a filling, and recommend an occlusal night splint to protect your teeth from night-time grinding.

Warm regards,
Dr. Vik

findings.chiefComplaint: Acute throbbing sensitivity on the lower left quadrant when tapping.
findings.history: Daily brushing reported; flossing is irregular. Mild sensitivity to cold fluids.
findings.toothFindings: FDI Tooth 33: Deep carious lesion requiring restoration. FDI Tooth 24: Stable restoration. FDI Tooth 16: Pulpitis detected requiring root canal treatment. FDI Tooth 42: Checked for mobility.
findings.findingsGingival: Localized gingivitis. Periodontal pocket depths recorded at 3-2-3 mm.
findings.diagnosis: Symptomatic pulpitis on tooth 16 and tooth 33. Localized gingivitis.
findings.treatmentPerformed: Thermal and percussion diagnostic tests. Initial excavation of decay on tooth 16, emergency pulp extirpation started.
findings.recommendations: Maintain brushing twice daily. Enhance flossing daily. Complete root canal therapy on tooth 16 and composite filling on tooth 33.

transcript.text: David, looking at your gums today, we have isolated deep pockets measuring 5mm in the upper right and lower left quadrants with subgingival calculus.
Is that why they bleed when I floss?
Yes, active periodontal inflammation. I strongly recommend scheduling two 45-minute appointments for quadrant root planing and subgingival debridement.
